{{Infobox Quest |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= File:BotW Forbidden City Entry.png }} |caption= |type= Main |game= BotW |giver= [[Benja]] |location= Gerudo Town |prereq= |reward= Access to [[Gerudo Town]] |previous= "{{Color BotW|Main Quest|[[Seek Out Impa]]}}" |next= {{List| * "{{Color BotW|Main Quest|[[Divine Beast Vah Naboris (Quest)|Divine Beast Vah Naboris]]}}" * "{{Color BotW|Side Quest|[[Medicinal Molduga]]}}" * "{{Color BotW|Side Quest|[[The Secret Club's Secret]]}}" * "{{Color BotW|Shrine Quest|[[The Seven Heroines]]}}" * "{{Color BotW|Side Quest|[[Tools of the Trade]]}}" }} }} "{{Term/Store|Forbidden City Entry||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Main Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Forbidden City Entry}}
{{Color BotW|Main Quest|Gerudo Town}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== If [[Link]] tries to enter [[Gerudo Town]], the guards will stop him, as men are not allowed inside.{{Cite|Freeze! Where do you think you're going?! Not into town—that's for sure! No voe allowed. Off with you!|Dorrah|BotW}} However, he can find a [[Hylian]] man named [[Benja]] nearby, where he is watching the main entrance. When asked if he is spying, Benja will become flustered and refute the claim.{{Cite|[Are you spying?] What?! N-no! I'm not a spy!|Benja|BotW}} He explains that he is the leader of a [[Merchant]] caravan that has been stalled at [[Kara Kara Bazaar]].{{Cite|I'm a merchant! I may not look like it, but I'm actually the leader of a caravan! I've traveled all the way here, but this town doesn't allow men to go in. So...that's why I...had to...um...|Benja|BotW}} Link asks once again if he is spying, Benja insists that he is conducting research.{{Cite|[Are you spying?] It's research! RESEARCH!|Benja|BotW}} Through his research, Benja has found information on sneaking into Gerudo Town.{{Cite|And think what you want, but I've finally found some key info on how to sneak into {{Color BotW|Blue|Gerudo Town}}!|Benja|BotW}} If Link asks about this information, Benja will gladly share his tale.{{Cite|[What info?] Heheheh... Well, allow me to share with you...my heroic tale!|Benja|BotW}} Benja has been attempted to access Gerudo Town for almost a week with no success,{{Cite|It's been close to a week now... The guards have kicked me out more times than I can count... I almost gave up hope...|Benja|BotW}} but then he heard about a man who managed to slip inside.{{Cite|{{Big|HOWEVER!!}} I have learned only recently of a {{Color BotW|Red|man that slipped into}} this well-guarded town!|Benja|BotW}} He has heard rumors that this man travels between Kara Kara Bazaar and Gerudo Town.{{Cite|I heard that man is frequently traveling between {{Color BotW|Blue|Kara Kara Bazaar}} and Gerudo Town.|Benja|BotW}} Therefore, he has been waiting at the entrance to Gerudo Town to try and spot him.{{Cite|I've been waiting here, trying to spot him as he travels!|Benja|BotW}} Once he is done speaking, the [[Main Quest]] will begin. To find the rumored man, Link must go to the Kara Kara Bazaar and ask around about a suspicious male Merchant. If Link asks [[Maike]] about the man, she suggests that he asks one of the [[Hylian]] merchants at the Bazaar instead.{{Cite|Anyway, there are Hylian merchants here, too. Why don't you go ask one of them?|Maike|BotW}} If Link asks [[Emri]] about the man, she tells him that she can recall a female Merchant who frequents the [[General Store]] in the [[Kara Kara Bazaar Inn]].{{Cite|Still... Yeah, I can think of someone... That one vai merchant in full Gerudo garb... She frequents the {{Color BotW|Red|general store}} a lot.|Emri|BotW}} If Link asks [[Robsten]] about the man, he also recalls seeing a Hylian girl at the General Store.{{Cite|There was that pretty Hylian gal at the {{Color BotW|Red|general store}}. It's unusual to see a Hylian girl dressed like a Gerudo...|Robsten|BotW}} If Link asks [[Ripp]] about the man, she recalls a particular female Merchant at the Kara Kara Bazaar Inn who wore [[Gerudo]] clothes.{{Cite|Although... Now that you mention it, one merchant in particular did stand out to me.|Ripp|BotW}}{{Cite|I saw a {{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian vai}} merchant at the inn before. She was wearing traditional Gerudo clothes, which caught my eye.|Ripp|BotW}} Ripp reasons that the Merchant is probably still at the Bazaar because [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]] is scaring people from traveling.{{Cite|She's probably still around town; that {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast}} is scaring a lot of people out of traveling.|Ripp|BotW}} If Link goes to the General Store and asks [[Shaillu]] about a sneaky guy, she mentions a Hylian girl who likes to relax on the roof.{{Cite|There's a {{Color BotW|Red|Hylian vai}} who likes to relax on the roof. Though in the afternoon, it's probably too hot up there.|Shaillu|BotW}} On the roof of the Kara Kara Bazaar Inn, Link can find the mysterious Hylian woman, who turns out to be a Merchant named [[Vilia]].{{Cite|Oh, my. What a lovely young lad you are. Do you need something from me?|Vilia|BotW}} She claims not to know anyting about a man sneaking into Gerudo Town and apologizes for not being able to help.{{Cite|What's that? You've heard about {{Color BotW|Red|a man}} who snuck into {{Color BotW|Blue|Gerudo Town}}? Oh, I don't know anything about him... Sorry I couldn't be more help.|Vilia|BotW}} When Link investigates her more closely, she becomes embarrassed.{{Cite|Heehee... You're making my cheeks warm looking at me like that.|Vilia|BotW}} If Link compliments her beauty, Vilia says that her clothing only enhances her looks.{{Cite|[You're very beautiful!] Oh, such a nice thing to say! And I'm sure you'd agree that these clothes only help my looks, right?|Vilia|BotW}}{{Note|If Link accuses Vilia of being a man, she will dismiss his claims and send him away.{{Cite|Oh, my! You sure say the funniest things, young man. Anyway, if you don't need anything, you should be off, then.|Vilia|BotW}}}} She offers to sell Link the [[Gerudo Outfit]] for 600 [[Rupee]]s, which she promises will make people see him differently.{{Cite|Now that I think about it, this style would look quite fetching on you... I'd have to charge you, of course, but I bet people would see you completely differently if you wore them! What do you think? Do you want to buy them for...{{Color BotW|Red|600 rupees}}?|Vilia|BotW}} After buying it, Link changes into the Gerudo clothing as Vilia looks away.{{Cite|Heehee... I have the perfect outfit for you! Go ahead and change into it right now. Don't worry. I'll look away...|Vilia|BotW}} When Vilia sees Link in his new clothes, she says that Link is a "good-lookin' gal" and doubts that anyone would suspect that he is a man.{{Cite|{{Big|♪Eeeeeeeee!♪ You look adorable!!}} Ahhh heeheehee... Just as I thought! You make for quite a {{Color BotW|Red|good-lookin' gal}}. That's a traditional Gerudo outfit. It's such a striking look around here, I doubt anyone would even suspect that you're a man!|Vilia|BotW}} Vilia also explains that the Gerudo Outfit helps with the scorching [[Temperature]]s in the [[Gerudo Desert]],{{Cite|On top of that, it breathes so well that it's sure to help you deal with the desert heat... At least a little!|Vilia|BotW}} referring to its heat-resistant [[Set Bonus]]. While wearing the full Outfit, Link appears to be female to everyone and can walk into Gerudo Town undisturbed. After walking into the Town, the Main Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | You heard of a man at the Kara Kara Bazaar who found a way to sneak into Gerudo Town, a place men are forbidden from entering.

Try and locate some people who know his whereabouts. |- | 2 | You were able to find the man who snuck into Gerudo Town, and you got a Gerudo outfit from him.

Put that on and you'll be able to pass for a woman while you're wearing it... |- | Complete | You snuck into Gerudo Town successfully!

You were able to fool the town guards by disguising yourself in a Gerudo outfit. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Benja * Gerudo Outfit * Gerudo Town * Vilia }} {{Notes}} {{Ref}} {{Categories |main-quests= BotW }}
